title: Thoughts on LLM test-time compute vs training-time compute: the frontier has fundamentally shifted.
title_en: Thoughts on LLM test-time compute vs training-time compute: the frontier has fundamentally shifted.
title_zh: Karpathy 深度长文：大模型测试时算力（推理计算）与预训练算力的平衡法则已发生根本性范式转移。
summary_en: Pre-training is hitting data walls; test-time compute and reinforcement learning over search spaces is where all the new exponent lies.
summary_zh: 预训练正在逼近人类高质量文本的数据天花板；而在搜索空间中的测试时算力（Inference Compute）与强化学习才是全新指数级增长的真正来源
quote_en: Pre-training is hitting data walls; test-time compute and reinforcement learning over search spaces is where all the new exponent lies.
quote_zh: 预训练正在逼近人类高质量文本的数据天花板；而在搜索空间中的测试时算力（Inference Compute）与强化学习才是全新指数级增长的真正来源。
full_text_en: A few thoughts on modern reasoning models: Pretraining teaches the base language and world facts, but test-time search and self-correction is where the actual problem-solving intelligence emerges.
full_text_zh: 关于现代推理模型的一些思考：预训练教会模型基础语言与世界事实，但测试时搜索与自我纠错反思才是真正解决高难度问题智能的涌现所在。
author: Andrej Karpathy
author_role: Eureka Labs 创始人 / 前 Tesla AI 负责人

title: Project GR00T 2.0: Unified foundation model for humanoid robots across manipulation and agile locomotion.
title_en: Project GR00T 2.0: Unified foundation model for humanoid robots across manipulation and agile locomotion.
title_zh: Jim Fan 详解 Project GR00T 2.0：面向人形机器人的统一通用基座大模型，同时驾驭精细操作与敏捷运动。
summary_en: Physical AI needs world models, not just video tokenizers. The gap between simulation and real hardware is finally closing via massive synthetic data.
summary_zh: 物理世界 AI 需要的是真正的因果物理世界模型，而非单纯的视频分词器。通过海量合成数据物理仿真，虚拟与现实硬件的鸿沟正在加速弥合
quote_en: Physical AI needs world models, not just video tokenizers. The gap between simulation and real hardware is finally closing via massive synthetic data.

full_text_en: Proud to reveal GR00T 2.0 at GTC. Trained on trillions of simulated interaction steps in Isaac Sim, robots can now zero-shot generalize to unfamiliar tools and environments.
full_text_zh: 在 GTC 上正式揭晓 GR00T 2.0。基于 Isaac Sim 中数万亿次仿真交互步数预训练，人形机器人现已能零样本泛化至从未见过的工具与复杂环境。
